Bulletin No: 02 MHA/2026/08/30/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for High Waves.
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 04.00 p.m. 30 August 2026
Valid for the period until 04.00 p.m. 31 August 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Puttalam to Pottuvil via Colombo,
Galle and Matara.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The wave height may increase about
(2.0 – 3.0) meters in the sea areas off
the coast extending from Puttalam to
Pottuvil via Colombo, Galle and
Matara.
There is a possibility of seawater
inundation over the near shore areas
extending from Chilaw to Matara via
Colombo and Galle.
Naval and fishing communities
engaged in activities in the
aforementioned sea areas, as well as
coastal communities living in the
aforementioned nearshore areas, are
advised to remain vigilant in this
regard.
